description: Signing of the Agreement on the Mutual Recognition of Driving Licenses between Italy and Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - A Bilateral Agreement on the mutual recognition of driving licenses was entered into between the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Republic of Italy in 2011, and the said Agreement expired in 2021. Both parties have reached a consensus to update the Agreement, incorporating technical amendments thereto, and re-enact the same. As per the provisions of the said Agreement, a mechanism will be established for Sri Lankans residing in Italy for less than 06 years and holding a valid Sri Lankan driving license obtained prior to acquiring Italian residency to obtain an Italian driving license by way of conversion of their driving licenses and for Italian nationals residing in Sri Lanka to have their valid Italian driving licenses converted into Sri Lankan driving licenses. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to sign an Agreement between the two parties on the mutual recognition of driving licenses, was approved by the Cabinet.
